optimized_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM store_sales
JOIN (
    SELECT * 
    FROM time_dim 
    WHERE t_hour = 8 AND t_minute >= 30
) AS filtered_time 
ON store_sales.ss_sold_time_sk = filtered_time.t_time_sk
JOIN (
    SELECT * 
    FROM household_demographics 
    WHERE hd_dep_count = 0
) AS filtered_hdemo 
ON store_sales.ss_hdemo_sk = filtered_hdemo.hd_demo_sk
JOIN (
    SELECT * 
    FROM store 
    WHERE s_store_name = 'ese'
) AS filtered_store 
ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = filtered_store.s_store_sk
ORDER BY COUNT(*)
LIMIT 100
